questions.prompt: Why could Clumsy search farther than the others?
choices: Clumsy could see over the ferns.
questions.answer: Clumsy could see over the ferns.
questions.evidenceText: Clumsy could see over all the ferns, past the waterfall, all the way to the Long Meadow and beyond.

questions.prompt: Where did Clumsy spot Dozy's pillow?
What did Dozy do after thanking Clumsy and Wiggly?
questions.evidenceText: Thank you, said Dozy. Both of you. Then Dozy fell asleep, right there, on the spot.
